verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party MCP server / AI Connector lets users operate Canva through natural language from their AI assistants. Documented operations cover generating designs from text, applying targeted edits via natural language commands, searching the library, exporting and resizing, managing assets and brand kits, and adding comments. The evidence is vendor documentation only, and some tools such as resize-design are rate-limited and restricted to Pro and above plans. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operation works reliably, documentation of natural-language command coverage inside the native Canva editor (Canva AI appears only glancingly), and clarity on plan gating across the full toolset.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
